feeds.title: MiddleWeb
feeds.description: MiddleWeb is all about middle school & the middle grades with a sharp focus on teaching and learning in grades 4-8. Since 1996, we've been providing resources for teachers, school leaders, parents and others interested in the success of young adolescents.

feeds.title: Maneuvering the Middle Blog
feeds.description: Maneuvering the Middle is an education blog with valuable tips for lesson planning, classroom technology, and math concepts in the middle school classroom. Maneuvering the Middle started as a side hobby and one woman show. Now, it has an entire team of geniuses behind who are focused on supporting teachers from customer service and technology to curriculum design.

feeds.title: Teacher Twins Blog
feeds.description: Hello! We are the Teacher Twins, Kimberly and Tammie. We both have 28 years of teaching experience in middle school math and science. Kimberly is currently teaching 7th grade math and science and has been in seventh grade for most of her 28 years of teaching. Tammie is currently teaching 8th grade math and science and has been for most of her 28 years of teaching. We both teach the advanced math class as well as the Inclusion math class in our grade level.

feeds.title: Musings from the Middle School Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Musings from the Middle School. A blog about teaching middle school ELA and math. I'm Jenna and I'm a middle school teacher in south Jersey. I married my teacher-husband in 2008 and together we have four beautiful kiddos.

feeds.title: Middle School Math Man Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my middle school math blog. I'm excited you are here! Teaching middle school math is such an important, but often challenging, task. All of my middle school math ideas and resources are designed to engage students in learning math and make math fun. The Middle School Math Man blog has everything you need to make math engaging for your students. Many of these activities and resources are perfect for math centers during math workshop.

feeds.title: Math = Love
feeds.description: Math = Love is a blog run by Sarah Carter, a high school math teacher from Oklahoma. She creates hands-on math activities, logic puzzles, and classroom resources designed to make math engaging and accessible to students and fellow teachers.

feeds.title: Thinking Mathematically
feeds.description: Hello everyone and welcome to my blog. My name is Mark and I write about Mathematics education. I am a Teacher, Instructional Coach, and Life-long Learner. Passionately curious about education. As a classroom teacher, I have taught grades 5-8.

feeds.title: Algebra's Friend
feeds.description: I share teaching ideas in math as well as thoughts about education in general. I am an educator and my experience in schools varies widely. I have had the privilege of serving students in positions as a classroom teacher, a district consultant, and school principal.

feeds.title: Little Room Under the Stairs
feeds.description: My name is Misty Miller. I taught for 19 years as a Special Ed Resource teacher. During my years of teaching, I taught remediation math and language arts to students in grades K-8 in the elementary and middle school setting. A blog from a former middle school/jr high special education resource teacher teaching remediation math.

feeds.title: I Speak Math
feeds.description: Hi! I am Julie. I am currently teaching Algebra 2 at a private school in North Carolina. I spend every spare moment planning, researching new ways to teach math, and reading blogs.
